readerCopy.body: Responsibility can make leaving an old arrangement feel wrong long after the arrangement has stopped being useful. When Saturn opposes the North Node, duty and forward movement face each other directly, making a known role, promise, institution, or long-standing commitment the strongest argument for staying. The responsibility may still be legitimate. Keeping a promise does not always require preserving every condition of the structure in which the promise was made.
